sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] Baghaei: 'Washington's contempt for diplomacy is once again laid bare. President Trump's admission that he never believed in the Islamabad MoU and considered it a waste of time exposes the hollowness of their diplomatic commitments.' He added Iran sees 'nothing new' in US reneging, and that there is 'absolutely no justification for European states and other apologists for Washington to continue whitewashing US misconduct.' This is Tehran's position on the MoU, not an agreed fact about the MoU's text or status.
sections.what_verified: Primary-source single family: Baghaei's own X post (T1 official/primary), carried by Times of India (T3) liveblog -- the carrier is not a second family, same exception as the Araghchi record (totw-20261028-1600-05).
sections.what_disputed: Trump's position is the mirror image: Tehran is 'tapping it along' and delaying (totw-20261028-2000-01). The MoU's actual text and status are not publicly verified in retrieved material.
sections.why_matters: Tehran answers Trump's clock: the MoU is dead, diplomacy is 'contempt'. Runs as the other side of 2000-01, not as a standalone deal story.
